title: Cheddar Bay Chicken Bake
notes: PARTIAL — VIDEO ONLY. Posted by "Crystal - The Cooking Mama" on Facebook Reels. No written recipe was found in the video caption or comments — multiple commenters explicitly asked for the recipe and one reply confirmed "No recipe" was ever posted. From the video and comment thread, this appears to be a casserole-style bake: a chicken and cream-of-chicken-soup filling in a 9x13 glass baking dish, topped with a cheddar-bay-biscuit-style topping, baked and then broiled briefly (one commenter said ~3 minutes) until golden, garnished with parsley and melted cheddar. Commenter-suggested variations: swap cream of chicken soup for cheddar cheese soup; use pre-made frozen cheddar bay biscuits on top instead of a homemade biscuit mix; add diced potatoes or frozen hash browns to the filling for heartiness; substitute hamburger meat for chicken; stir in a can of mixed vegetables; add an extra stick of butter to the seasoning packet. Recommend re-watching the video directly or asking the poster for the actual recipe if an exact version is wanted.
